name: Reveal Boxes
description: Grid of dark glass step cards where a colored gradient circle grows from the corner to flood each card on load, staggered one after another, with a hover lift and glow.
contents: Grid of cards, each with a step badge, title, description and status dot
behavior: On mount each card fill scales up from the bottom right corner with an overshoot ease, staggered by index
Hovering lifts the card, brightens the fill, reveals a faint grid pattern and turns text white
editableByProps: Number of cards, step labels, titles and descriptions
Fill gradients or colors, stagger and duration of the reveal
Grid columns and gaps, hover transform, backdrop glows, background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the corner the fill grows from
needsCodeEdit.where: transform values using translate(100%, 100%) scale(0) in the fill div style

needsCodeEdit.change: Change card height or card surface colors
needsCodeEdit.where: className of the card div containing h-52

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Reveal animation plays once after mount, a placeholder is rendered before mount
